verdict.rationale: Vanta's API page says it can bulk assign owners to resources, mark resources out of scope, and offload employees in batches (vanta-docs-23). The API reference also describes the API as built to "automate bulk actions" (vanta-docs-58), and list endpoints filter many items at once (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-7). Missing for 10: documentation of specific bulk/batch endpoints and their limits (per-endpoint rate limits such as 10 req/min on uploads suggest item-by-item calls), evidence that the MCP server or AI agent can run bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
